response.sql:
WITH nationality_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    c.nationality,
    SUM(cr.points) as total_points,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr.constructorId) as num_constructors
  FROM constructors c
  INNER JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.nationality
)
SELECT 
  nationality,
  total_points,
  num_constructors,
  num_constructors - AVG(CAST(num_constructors AS REAL)) OVER () as difference_from_avg
FROM nationality_stats

assumptions.assumption: "For each constructor nationality" means only nationalities that have at least one constructor with results in constructorResults. The phrase "with constructor results" implies we display only relevant nationalities.
"Ignoring missing points" refers to standard SQL SUM() behavior, which excludes NULL values from aggregation.

alternatives.interpretation: Show all nationalities from the constructors table, including those with zero constructors having results. Interprets "For each constructor nationality" as every distinct nationality in constructors, and calculates average across all of them (including zero counts).
alternatives.sql:
WITH nationality_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    c.nationality,
    COALESCE(SUM(cr.points), 0) as total_points,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr.constructorId) as num_constructors
  FROM constructors c
  LEFT JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.nationality
)
SELECT 
  nationality,
  total_points,
  num_constructors,
  num_constructors - AVG(CAST(num_constructors AS REAL)) OVER () as difference_from_avg
FROM nationality_stats
